defaultsNote: Captures record one power-amp Level/Presence without saying side A or B; they are shown in the A position.

fullName: Darkglass Ultra plugin · Microtubes B7K Ultra pedal
defaultsNote: The captures are named “Darkglass Ultimate”, but describe the Darkglass Ultra plugin. The mid-switch frequencies follow the order printed on the pedal. Bypass, LEDs and jacks are not recorded and are not shown.

fullName: Darkglass Ultimate plugin · Microtubes B7K Ultra pedal section
defaultsNote: Only the plugin's B7K/VU pedal section is compared; its compressor, fuzz, cab and EQ settings stay in the description. The mid-switch frequencies follow the order printed on the pedal.

Channel 1 has its own Treble/Middle/Bass; channels 2 and 3 share theirs, plus the Air and Gain Lo/Hi switches. Sound Style and Variac are rear-panel switches, shown at the left. Pre EQ “Normal”/“Middle” in descriptions means Mid.

Only the preamp's per-channel controls are captured; Presence, Master, Excursion and the rear switches belong to the power amp section. The descriptions write Gain Mode as a second “Gain” line (Lead/Plexi).
The power amp section's controls only: Presence, Master Volume and Excursion on the front, Sound Style (written “Style”) and Variac on the rear panel.

fullName: Mark IIC+ · head with 5-band graphic EQ
defaultsNote: The PULL labels above the knobs are the pull switches. Lead Drive, Lead Master and its Pull Bright only count while Pull Lead is on (dimmed otherwise). Presence and the Simul-Class / Class A switch sit on the rear panel; they are shown where the standby and power switches are. The EQ in/auto switch isn't recorded by any capture, so it is left out (every capture states the slider positions).

Captures call the channels A (Normal) and B (Drive); CHANNEL SELECT on the panel switches between them, and the controls the other channel doesn't use are dimmed. The knobs are printed 1–12; a few captures write 0, shown fully counter-clockwise like 1. Reverb is on the panel but no capture records it: shown, not matched.

fullName: Hot Rod Deluxe · power amp section (6V6)
defaultsNote: The power amp section's only recorded control is Presence; the knobs are printed 1–12 and a capture at 0 is shown fully counter-clockwise like 1.

fullName: Mark III (red stripe) · head with 5-band graphic EQ
defaultsNote: Same faceplate as the Mark IIC+, with PULL RHYTHM 2 on Middle (captures write it “Pull Rhythm” or “Pull Rhythm2”). Captures that don’t use the lead circuit write the lead controls as N/A; they only count while Pull Lead is on (dimmed otherwise). Presence sits on the rear panel; it’s shown where the standby and power switches are.

definitionSource: front panel photos + capture settings (rear-panel Presence and Master per the published panel layout)
defaultsNote: The channel labels on the panel (STRATO ▶, BROWN ▶, SHARK ▶, ◀ COUNTRY) pick the channel; captures call Country “Clean”. Brown and Strato share the top-row tone stack. The controls the selected channel doesn’t use are dimmed. Presence and Master sit on the rear panel; they are shown where the power switch is.

fullName: Fish preamp into a Stereo Simul-Class 2:Ninety power amp · rack
defaultsNote: The Fish above the Simul-Class 2:Ninety it was captured through; captures write each channel’s level and gain knobs as plain “Volume” and “Gain”. Captures call Country “Clean”, and one sets its switch to the middle position (between Jazz and Funk).

The amp has two channels with the same six knobs; the captures don’t say which they used, and as high-gain settings they’re treated as channel 2, so only that row is shown, next to the shared M.Volume. Two captures have an Xotic BB Preamp in front; its settings are in the description but not compared.
The status LED, bypass footswitch, jacks and the lower body of the pedal are left out.
